entries.summary: Adds municipality_id and barangay_id FK columns on grievances.
Required Municipality/Barangay after Project; PAPS autofill from profile (read-only); non-PAPS project-scoped selects and latest-details autofill.
Server validation via Grievance::validateLocationFields; API store/update accepts municipality_id and barangay_id.
latest-details returns municipality/barangay; project municipalities/barangays APIs allow grievance capabilities.
E2E grievance create selects project municipality and barangay via bootstrap helper.
